title: RoleCharter
description: Definition of a role that does not exist yet, written before any candidate runs. Candidates cannot be compared fairly without a definition of the job, and the evaluation set must be sealed before the candidates exist so it cannot be written to favour one of them.

role.description: Single responsibility. If it needs two sentences, it is two roles.

gap_trigger.description: hard_gap: no capability match. soft_gap: nominal match, first-pass yield <40% over >=8 runs. chronic_escalation: >=3 human escalations with no code defect found.

exit_criteria.description: Also the probation bar: the provisional winner must sustain these across 5 work orders before promotion to permanent.

sealed_cases.description: Historical or synthetic tasks of the same class with known-good outcomes. Sealed before candidates exist.

recurrence_projection.description: Projected work orders of this class. Genesis costs 3x one work order and runs only at >=5; below that, route to a generalist with a human checkpoint.

candidates.description: Exactly one dimension varies between candidates: how procedural knowledge is composed. Charter, context pack, tools, budget, model tier and sealed task are identical.

gate0_passed.description: A candidate failing Gate 0 is disqualified outright — correctness is a qualifier, not a weighted term.

status.description: provisional -> permanent requires 5 work orders sustaining exit_criteria. Probation failure re-opens genesis with a revised charter; the runner-up is never promoted, having already lost on the same evidence.

harvested_patterns.description: Patterns the Commission marked approved in an eliminated candidate's dossier, folded into the winner's skill pack before termination. Without this, two thirds of the genesis cost buys nothing.
